post.description:
HTTP mapping convention (governs all annotations in this package):
- `chat_guid` values (e.g. `iMessage;-;+15551234567`) are hostile to URL
  paths and never appear in one — they ride in the request body, or in
  query parameters for reads.
- `message_guid` values (UUID-shaped, or proxy-virtual `spc-*`) are
  path-safe and map to resource paths.
- Non-CRUD mutations use the `:customVerb` suffix style (AIP-136).

v1AddParticipantsRequest.description:
Adds one or more participants. An empty `addresses` list
is rejected with `INVALID_ARGUMENT`.

originalGuid.description:
Set on attachments superseded by an edit. Points to the original
attachment GUID this row replaced.

isHidden.description:
Mirrors chat.db `attachment.hide_attachment`. `true` when the
attachment is hidden from the conversation surface (e.g. tapback
sticker artifacts).

companionKind.description:
Set iff this attachment ships with a sidecar; the server never emits
`COMPANION_KIND_UNSPECIFIED`.

v1AttachmentRef.description:
Reference to an attachment by either its server-local on-disk path or
its GUID.

guid.description:
System-assigned chat GUID. Stable across renames and participant
changes; the canonical key for every chat-scoped RPC.

chatIdentifier.description:
Apple's `chat_identifier` column. For 1:1 chats this is the peer's
E.164 phone or email; for group chats it is the synthetic group ID.

groupId.description: Stable iMessage group ID. Set on group chats only.

isFiltered.description:
`true` when Apple has routed the chat to "Unknown Senders" / the
junk filter.

unreadCount.description:
Absent when the underlying count is unavailable (e.g. chat row not
yet hydrated). `0` is a real "all read" value, not "unknown".

v1Chat.description:
Canonical projection of a row in chat.db's `chat` table joined with its
participants and (optionally) its most recent message.

v1CompanionKind.description:
Sidecar attachment kind. Today only Live Photo's `.mov` companion is
modelled.

backwardCompatText.description:
Plain-text fallback for recipients on older clients that cannot
render rich edits. Absent = derive from `new_text`.

v1FriendLocationType.description:
LEGACY   stored last-known fix from Find My's cache
  LIVE     real-time fix from an active sharing session
  SHALLOW  approximate fix from a low-power background source
v1FriendLocationType.title:
Source / freshness of a friend's location, mirroring Apple's
`FMFLocationType`:

isSilencedByFocus.description:
True when Messages currently shows this address as silenced by Focus.
False also covers unknown, not shared, and not silenced.

mimeType.description:
MIME type of `data`. Always set on success; a missing icon returns
`NOT_FOUND` instead of an empty payload.

isDeliveredQuietly.description: Monterey+. Delivered without firing a recipient notification.

didNotifyRecipient.description:
Monterey+. The recipient's device was actually woken to surface the
message. Pair with `is_delivered_quietly` to distinguish silent vs
notified delivery.

sendErrorCode.description:
Apple's internal send-error code (0 = no error). Distinct from any
gRPC error returned for the RPC itself.

isSystemMessage.description: Synthetic system row (e.g. "iMessage activated", group name change).

isForward.description:
Mirrors chat.db `message.is_forward`. Set on Continuity SMS-forwarded
rows and a handful of Apple-internal forwarding paths; rarely true
on iMessage traffic.

isDelayed.description:
Mirrors chat.db `message.is_delayed`. Set on rows queued for
scheduled delivery (iOS 18 "Send Later"); cleared once Apple
dispatches the send.

isSpam.description:
Mirrors chat.db `message.is_spam`. Apple sets this on rows its
junk filter has classified as spam; user-visible state is
controlled at chat scope via `Chat.is_filtered`.

dataDetectorResultsPresent.description:
Apple's data detectors found URLs / phone numbers / addresses in
the body.

isArchived.description:
Mirrors chat.db `message.is_archive`. Per-row archival flag,
distinct from the chat-level `Chat.is_archived` view state. Set
on individual messages Apple has hidden from default queries.

isServiceMessage.description: Carrier or platform service message (e.g. SMS billing notice).

isCorrupt.description: chat.db reports the row as corrupt; content fields may be partial.

isExpirable.description: Disappearing / ephemeral message that will expire client-side.

shareStatus.description:
Name-and-photo sharing status. `0` = not shared, `1` = shared. Raw
mirror of Apple's column; promoted to a typed enum is future work.

shareDirection.description:
Name-and-photo sharing direction. `0` = received from peer, `1` =
sent by local user.

groupTitle.description:
Set on `MESSAGE_ITEM_TYPE_GROUP_NAME_CHANGE` rows: the new group
title.

chatActionType.description:
Subtype for `MESSAGE_ITEM_TYPE_CHAT_ACTION` rows (Apple private
schema). Promoted to a typed enum is future work; see
domain `ChatActionType`.

threadOriginatorGuid.description:
Apple's `thread_originator_guid` (BigSur+): GUID of the message
that started this reply thread. Reliable indicator of a public
threaded reply.

threadOriginatorPart.description:
Apple's `thread_originator_part`: opaque part locator within the
originator (string form, e.g. `0:0/0`).

replyToGuid.description:
Raw Apple `reply_to_guid` storage column. Frequently populated on
ordinary non-reply messages and may point at unrelated rows;
surface for diagnostics only. Prefer `reply_target_guid` to
determine a real reply.

replyTargetGuid.description:
Canonical public reply target. Set iff `thread_originator_guid` is
a reliable public threaded-reply target (non-self, non-empty).

destinationCallerId.description:
The local Caller ID (phone / email) the message was sent from or
delivered to. Apple uses `e:` / `p:` prefixes.

partCount.description: Ventura+. Number of bubble parts in a multipart message.

cachedRoomNames.description:
Denormalized group chat name cached on the message row by Apple
("room" is Apple's internal term for what surface APIs call a
chat).

reactionTargetGuid.description:
Tapback-row fields. Set iff this Message row is itself a tapback
against another message (i.e. a synthetic associated row), in which
case `reaction_target_guid` points at the message being reacted to.
Plain user messages leave all three absent.

appliedReactions.description: Aggregated current state from associated rows that target this message.

v1Message.description:
Canonical projection of a row in chat.db's `message` table, joined with
its attachments and any associated tapback.

v1MessageAppliedReaction.description:
One currently-applied reaction folded onto its target message from an
associated tapback row.

v1MessageContent.description:
Rendered content of an inbound or persisted message, with attachments,
mentions, and effects.

v1MessageItemType.description:
Discriminates regular messages from the synthetic "system" rows Apple
uses to record chat lifecycle changes.

Wire values mirror chat.db `message.item_type`.

`0` is a real "normal" value, not "unspecified".

v1MessageMention.description: `@`-mention into a UTF-16 range of the message text.

v1MessagePart.description:
One bubble in an outgoing multipart send. Exactly one of `text` or
`attachment` is set per part; mentions and formatting apply to `text`.

v1MessagePlacedSticker.description:
One sticker currently placed onto its target message from an associated
sticker row.

v1MessageReactionKind.description:
Tapback families understood by Apple's Messages stack.

`EMOJI` and `STICKER` are the post-iOS 18 generic carriers; the wrapped
value is delivered out-of-band (`MessageReaction.emoji` for emoji
tapbacks, the associated message itself for sticker tapbacks).

Wire values are transport-internal. Apple stores tapback kind in a composite
`associated_message_type` column, not as a direct integer match for these
tags.

 - MESSAGE_REACTION_KIND_STICKER: Carrier for sticker tapbacks.

The placed sticker arrives as its own attachment row, not as a
`MessageReaction`. Servers reject `SetReaction` calls that pass
`STICKER`; use `PlaceSticker` instead.

message.description:
Snapshot of the persisted message after Apple has accepted the send
and chat.db has been observed.

miniAppCardSession.description:
Present for mini-app card sends/updates. Save this handle and pass it to
the matching update RPC to replace the original card in place.

targetPartIndex.description:
Selects a single bubble in a multipart message. Absent = the whole
message root.

v1MiniAppCardSession.description:
Stable iMessage app-card handle returned by mini-app send/update RPCs.
Pass the latest session back to the matching update RPC. The `session_id`
remains stable across updates; `target_message_guid` identifies the original
bubble being replaced in place.

caption.description: Top-left, bold. The most prominent text slot.

image.description: JPEG preview image bytes. Server validates that the bytes decode as JPEG.

imageTitle.description: Overlay text shown above the image. Must be set together with `image`.

imageSubtitle.description:
Overlay text shown below `image_title`, above the image edge.
Requires `image`.

summary.description: Fallback text shown on surfaces that cannot render the full card.

address.description:
Canonical form: emails lowercased, phones E.164. May differ from the
request value's casing or whitespace.

country.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, when known. The chat.db address lookup normalizes it
to uppercase; mappers preserve the value they receive.

v1MultiServiceAddressInfo.description:
An address paired with every service observed for it.

`services` is emitted in canonical (iMessage, SMS, RCS) order. Clients
should treat it as a set, not a sequence. GetAddressInfo returns NOT_FOUND
instead of this message when the address has no observed handle rows.

v1PollParticipantVote.description: One selected option in a participant's current vote snapshot.

v1RemoveParticipantsRequest.description:
Removes one or more participants. An empty `addresses`
list is rejected with `INVALID_ARGUMENT`.

v1ReplyTarget.description:
Pointer to the message being replied to. `target_part_index` selects a
single bubble in a multipart message; absent means the whole message.

v1RequestFriendLocationSharingRequest.description:
Sends a visible Find My request card to `address` in `chat_guid`.
`address` must be a participant in the chat.

Errors:
  INVALID_ARGUMENT  malformed address/chat_guid, or address is not in chat
  NOT_FOUND         chat is not visible to the current account

v1SendAttachmentMessageRequest.description:
Single-attachment send. The attachment is referenced either by GUID
(already uploaded via `AttachmentService.UploadAttachment`) or by an
absolute filesystem path readable by the local mutation process.

extensionBundleId.description: Bundle identifier of the iMessage extension target.

appName.description: Human-readable name of the owning app.

url.description: Absolute URL the recipient's installed extension receives on tap.

layout.description:
The visible layout of the card. Mirrors Apple's
`MSMessageTemplateLayout`; see `MiniAppLayout` for the rendering map.

appStoreId.description: Apple App Store numeric id of the owning app. When set, must be > 0.

live.description:
Whether to include MSMessageLiveLayout metadata. When unset, defaults to
false so the static layout remains visible.

v1SendMultipartMessageRequest.description: Multipart send: multiple bubbles delivered atomically.

v1SendTextMessageRequest.description:
Plain-text or rich-text send.

`enable_data_detection` enables Apple's data-detector pass.
`enable_link_preview` enables URL-preview generation.

data.description: Server infers MIME type and file extension from `data`.

isSet.description:
`true` adds or replaces the caller's reaction of this kind on the target.
`false` removes it.

address.description:
Canonical handle (E.164 phone or full email). Primary key for
client-side correlation.

longAddress.description: Fully formatted reverse-geocoded address (e.g. street + city + region).

shortAddress.description: Compact reverse-geocoded label (e.g. neighborhood or city only).

v1SharedFriendLocation.description:
A single currently shared friend location. Coordinates are absent while the
device is acquiring a fix (`is_locating_in_progress = true`).

v1SingleServiceAddressInfo.description:
An address bound to one concrete transport service. Used when the server
must identify a specific (handle, service) pair: message sender, chat
participant, etc.

v1StickerPlacement.description:
Spatial placement of a sticker on its target bubble. All values are in
Apple's normalised coordinate space.

v1TextFormat.description:
Inline rich-text run (bold, italic, expressive effect) over a UTF-16
range of the parent text.

v1TransferState.description:
Mirrors chat.db `attachment.transfer_state` (Apple `IMTransferState`); wire
values equal DB values, gaps included. Zero is `PENDING`, not
`UNSPECIFIED`; the server always populates this field.

extensionBundleId.description: Bundle identifier of the iMessage extension target.

appName.description: Human-readable name of the owning app.

url.description: Absolute URL the recipient's installed extension receives on tap.

layout.description: The replacement visible layout for the card.

appStoreId.description: Apple App Store numeric id of the owning app. When set, must be > 0.

live.description:
Whether to include MSMessageLiveLayout metadata. When unset, defaults to
false so the static layout remains visible.
